title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: A ball with diameter \(4\) inches starts at point \(A\) to roll along the track shown. The track is comprised of \(3\) semicircular arcs whose radii are \(R_1 = 100\) inches, \(R_2 = 60\) inches, and \(R_3 = 80\) inches, respectively. The ball always remains in contact with the track and does not slip. What is the distance in inches the center of the ball travels over the course from \(A\) to \(B\)?

solutions.text:
The ball has radius \(2\). As the ball rolls, its center follows semicircular arcs parallel to the track. On the first and third arcs the center path is inside the track arcs, so those radii are \(100-2=98\) and \(80-2=78\). On the middle arc the center path is outside the track arc, so that radius is \(60+2=62\).

The total distance traveled by the center is the sum of the three semicircle lengths: \[(98+62+78)\pi=238\pi.\]

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: The ball center follows offset semicircular arcs.
Subtract the ball radius from outside arcs and add it to the inside arc.
